name: shader_34e20b
vertexShader: attribute float aSize; uniform float uScale; uniform float uPulse; uniform float uSkyNear; varying vec3 vC; void main(){ vC = color; vec4 mv = modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0); gl_Position = projectionMatrix * mv; vec4 mvSky = mv; float skyK = clamp((-mvSky.z - uSkyNear) / 400.0, 0.0, 1.0); gl_Position.z = (0.99992 + 0.00006 * skyK) * gl_Position.w; gl_PointSize = aSize * (aSize > 1.0 ? uPulse : 1.0) * uScale / -mv.z; }
fragmentShader: uniform sampler2D map; varying vec3 vC; void main(){ gl_FragColor = vec4(vC * texture2D(map, gl_PointCoord).a, 1.0); }
